boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Arlington
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The University of Texas at Arlington
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Arlington food stops with current published late-hours information; check the linked location page before heading out because hours can change.

cards.title: Tacos El 24
cards.subtitle: 3311 E Division St, Arlington
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm service before leaving; this Arlington taco stop lists every day as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour taco option on East Division Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacos El 24 lists its 3311 E Division St Arlington location and shows it open 24 hours Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists this address as open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 200 E Abram St, Suite 100, Arlington
cards.notes: Check the bakery’s current ordering page before setting out; its opening announcement lists late-night in-store, pickup, and delivery service.
cards.short_summary: Cookies at the northeast edge of UTA’s campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ Arlington opening announcement identifies the shop at 200 E Abram St and states it is at the northeast edge of the UTA campus, with listed late-night hours.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies Opens First Arlington Location
cards.access_notes: The official announcement lists closing at 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 712 E Pioneer Pkwy
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Pioneer Parkway
cards.subtitle: 712 E Pioneer Pkwy, Arlington
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru if arriving after the lobby closes; the official location page lists drive-thru service through 4 a.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A Pioneer Parkway drive-thru with very late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 712 E Pioneer Pkwy Arlington drive-thru as operating from 4 a.m. to 4 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 712 E Pioneer Pkwy
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 4 a.m. daily; lobby hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Collins
cards.subtitle: 1101 N Collins, Arlington
cards.notes: For the late window, use the drive-thru rather than assuming dine-in is open; the official page lists the drive-thru through 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A North Collins drive-thru with 2 a.m. listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 1101 N Collins in Arlington as open until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1101 N Collins takeout and hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. daily; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Whataburger at Hwy 360 & Abram
cards.subtitle: 211 S Watson Rd, Arlington
cards.notes: This is a round-the-clock option when timing is uncertain; the location page lists both dine-in and drive-thru as 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official page lists the 211 S Watson Rd location’s drive-thru and dine-in service as 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 24-hour drive-thru, dine-in, and delivery; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: McDonald’s on East Arkansas Lane
cards.subtitle: 2575 E Arkansas Ln, Arlington
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant locator for ordering and route details; it currently lists both lobby and drive-thru as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour McDonald’s on East Arkansas Lane.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists its 2575 E Arkansas Ln Arlington restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists 24-hour restaurant/lobby and drive-thru service daily.

cards.title: Subway at Arlington Plaza Shopping Center
cards.subtitle: 1515B S Cooper St, Arlington
cards.notes: Confirm availability and place pickup through the restaurant page; this location lists store hours as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Subway location on South Cooper Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official page lists the Arlington Plaza Shopping Center restaurant at 1515B S Cooper St as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists 24-hour service Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Collins
cards.subtitle: 4431 S Collins St, Arlington
cards.notes: Use the official locator for pickup details; the restaurant page lists both drive-thru and dine-in service as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A South Collins Taco Bell listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 4431 S Collins St Arlington location’s drive-thru as open 24 hours daily and its dine-in service as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 4431 S Collins St restaurant and hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 24-hour drive-thru and dine-in hours; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Denny’s on South Cooper
cards.subtitle: 4928 S Cooper, Arlington
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official order page to check service details before you go; it identifies this Arlington restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner option on South Cooper Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page identifies the restaurant at 4928 S Cooper in Arlington and lists it as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day.

cards.title: Narah Café and Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 2896 W Pioneer Pkwy, Arlington
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s site before departing, especially on holidays; its published schedule extends to 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Pioneer Parkway café and restaurant with late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Narah Café and Restaurant lists its Arlington address at 2896 W Pioneer Pkwy and hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
